title: Indigenous Unmanned Systems to Be Showcased at Pokhran

blocks.content: Indigenous unmanned systems will be showcased for the Indian Air Force at the Pokhran Firing Range in Rajasthan in September 2026. The demonstration will include long-range unmanned aerial vehicles, swarm drone technologies, expendable surveillance drones, logistics drones, and one-way attack drones.

items: Pokhran is located in Rajasthan and has been associated with major military trials in India.
Long-range unmanned aerial vehicles can operate beyond 1,000 kilometres in some configurations.
Loitering drones are also called one-way attack drones in defence usage.
Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems is commonly abbreviated as Counter-UAS.
